problem.description: Two or three plain sentences on what is wrong or missing today.

solution.description: Two or three plain sentences on the outcome the ticket asks for, not a design.

items.description: A ticket or outside fact that must land first, with its key and status when known, and what it blocks.
What to build that the ticket leaves unclear, with the options and your recommendation.

key.description: The other ticket's key, from the list of the developer's other tickets.

why.description: One sentence naming the criterion, behaviour or file that ties the tickets.

relations.description: How this ticket depends on, repeats, contradicts or collides with the developer's other tickets. Empty when none do.
